purpose: R220 independent postflight tooling only after R218 COMPLETE. Do not inspect an in-progress R218 artifact and do not run estimator/science.
fail_closed_requirements: R236-D1: require artifact/preflight Actions run_attempt == 1 and independent Actions evidence run_attempt == 1; any other attempt is PROTOCOL_INVALID.

R236-D2: R220 must supply the independently downloaded Actions artifact ZIP plus Actions evidence containing run/job/artifact ID, exact artifact name, SHA256 digest, frozen head/arm/workflow/executor blobs and ancestry. The verifier hashes the ZIP and byte-compares every ZIP file to artifact-dir.
R236-D3: both --expected-panel and artifact R218_EXPECTED_PANEL.json must match frozen SHA256 c09fdf...; expected-panel blob must also be externally verified.
R236-D4: sha256.json must be a nonempty object whose keys exactly equal every other file in artifact-dir and every digest must match.

R236-D5: prelaunch artifact copy must match frozen SHA256 e7ca2c...; preflight gate keys must equal the exact frozen key set and all be true. Python and whest_version.json are checked locally; R220 Actions evidence must independently verify exact Python/NumPy/flopscope/whestbench versions from frozen workflow/run evidence.
R236-D6: every block must match exact dataset path+SHA and max_threads=1 in addition to budget/residual/shape/version.

R236-D7: all preflight and per-block mandatory telemetry files must exist and be nonempty; orchestrator/child taskset and /proc status CPU sets must match expected affinity; lscpu identity must match preflight; worker RUNNER_NAME and Azure region must be recorded and match external evidence.
independent_postflight_checks: Do not run until R218 is COMPLETE and R220 owns the audit.
Obtain Actions run/job metadata independently; require attempt 1, one crossover job, no rerun/rescue, successful run/job for a causal verdict.
Download the exact Actions artifact by artifact ID; preserve artifact ID/name/digest and pass both extracted directory and original ZIP to verifier.
Verify the Actions head is frozen arm head c8cb97dc...; arm parent is executor commit 85f5ba...; one-commit diff adds only research/R218_RUN_ARM.json.
Verify workflow blob d1fa..., executor blob 4563..., arm blob 542f..., expected-panel blob 8669..., prelaunch blob fe07..., estimator SHA256 86d9....
Verify artifact manifest exact completeness before interpreting any measurements.
Verify exact preflight gate names, exact versions and thread env; require CPU0+CPU1 allowed.
Verify worker name and region and all required preflight telemetry.
For every block require all mandatory telemetry; C0 child={0}, C1 child={1}, U child=inherited allowed set; orchestrator remains inherited allowed set.
Parse six raw reports; require 50 rows each, exact frozen panel/order/FLOPs, dataset path/SHA, budget, residual limit, width/depth, max_threads=1, whestbench 0.16.1.
Reconstruct all 300 observations and compare recomputed metrics to owner receipt.
C0/C1 versus U is descriptive only.

decision_rule.GO_CPU0_SPECIFIC: All artifact and external provenance gates pass AND primary_delta_s >= 0.020 AND cpu0_slower_count >= 35/50 AND failure_difference >= 10.
decision_rule.NO_GO_CPU0_SPECIFIC: All artifact and external provenance gates pass and any GO threshold fails.
decision_rule.PROTOCOL_INVALID: Any local contract gate fails, or supplied external Actions/artifact/source provenance is invalid.
decision_rule.PENDING_EXTERNAL_ACTIONS_PROVENANCE: All local artifact gates pass but no external Actions evidence has been supplied yet.

r220_actions_evidence_schema.artifact_digest_sha256: plain 64-hex SHA256 of independently downloaded artifact ZIP
r220_actions_evidence_schema.runner_region: must equal artifact Azure instance metadata compute.location

regression_contract: wrong artifact ID/name/digest or ZIP-directory mismatch must be rejected
wrong head/arm/workflow/executor/source pins must be rejected
modified expected panel or prelaunch must be rejected
missing/extra preflight gate keys or version drift must be rejected
wrong dataset path or max_threads must be rejected
missing mandatory telemetry or affinity mismatch must be rejected
explicit_limits: R237 does not inspect or interpret the in-progress R218 artifact.
R237 does not alter R217 thresholds or R218 workflow/executor/run/artifacts.
R237 does not execute whest/estimator/science or trigger Actions.
R237 does not access private/holdout data or submit.
R237 does not claim/start R220; R220 remains the authoritative postflight owner.
